method: Manual view of actual current portraits for20heroes, plus this lane actual source close views and sampled seven-clip sheets. Canonical full art fields are embedded verbatim for traceability; program output is not an art assessment.

required_art.silhouette: A broad inverted-triangle shoulder line over a compact waist, anchored by an oversized rounded kite shield on the left. The shield rises to eyebrow height when guarding, but stays below her eyes at rest.
required_art.face: Warm brown skin, square brows, dark eyes and a short black braid tucked behind the neck. Her calm, alert expression is readable without exaggerated facial animation.
required_art.costume: An ivory quilted coat sits under simplified steel breast and shoulder plates. A split navy tabard ends above the knees, leaving the leg silhouettes clear. Heavy boots and broad bracers make her planted stance apparent.
required_art.palette: Navy #25466B; ivory #E9E2CD; brushed steel #9EAAB5; restrained gold #C7A25B. Gold covers only the shield crest and two fasteners.
required_art.equipment: Left-hand kite shield with a raised rising-sun disk; short, broad fantasy sword in the right hand. Build the emblem as shallow geometry with a baked bevel, not dense engraving.
required_art.signature: The high curved shield, squared shoulder line, and single sun disk must survive a 96-pixel hero render.
required_art.materials: Use a shared armor master, a cloth instance and a small emissive crest mask. Keep roughness separation between plate, fabric and the leather shield grip; no mirror-polished surfaces.
required_art.back: A navy crossed strap carries a plain bedroll clasp; the braid sits clear of the shoulder plates. No long cape hides the back silhouette.
required_art.animation: Idle with weight on the rear foot and shield angled outward. Walk with measured short steps. Basic attacks use one readable right-hand sweep. The active lifts the shield before the crest lights; return to guard without whole-body root motion.
required_art.vfx: A thin warm-gold shell follows the shield silhouette and a brief low-opacity arc wraps the torso. Do not use a solid sphere that obscures nearby heroes.
required_art.audio: A firm boot placement, restrained metal knock, and short rounded shield chime. Avoid a booming impact on every basic attack.
required_art.risk: Shield/forearm intersections during attack recovery are the main deformation risk. Test full left-arm elevation and adjacent-hero visibility.

heroes.observed: Curved kite shield, quilt/tabard, sun disk, short braid, fitted face and sword fingers are present in source9 close views.
heroes.outstanding: Deep finger-web grooves remain visible; fine cuff/guard intersections and shield clearance need close continuous engine review.

required_art.silhouette: A bell-shaped short coat and a high open staff loop, balanced by a small medicine satchel. Her upper body stays narrower than a Guardian, with the staff serving as the long vertical accent.
required_art.face: Olive skin, hazel eyes, dark auburn hair in a loose bun, and a practical, attentive expression. A fabric headband frames her face without hiding it.
required_art.costume: Cream wool layers under a coral traveling mantle; the mantle is cut at the elbows for clean arm animation. Fitted trousers and walking boots replace a floor-length robe.
required_art.palette: Cream #F0E6CC; coral #CF7067; muted teal #538E8D; warm brass #BC9B58.
required_art.equipment: A polished wood staff ending in an open circular lantern and a square leather satchel with two large clasps. Small bottle shapes remain abstract accessories, never gameplay consumables.
required_art.signature: Circular staff head, coral shoulder mantle, and square hip satchel.
required_art.materials: Soft woven cloth, oiled wood, dull brass and one small lantern emissive area. Paint folds in broad groups rather than dense noise.
required_art.back: The mantle has a clean V seam; a wide satchel strap crosses from left shoulder to right hip. Keep the staff away from the bun in overhead poses.
required_art.animation: Idle checks the battlefield rather than fussing with props. Movement is brisk and balanced. Basics point the staff for a small light bolt. Mend traces a single clear upward curve before its effect leaves the lantern.
required_art.vfx: A warm-gold pulse travels to the selected ally and resolves as two rising leaflike arcs. The target health bar briefly indicates effective healing, not overheal.
required_art.audio: Soft bell pair and airy arrival tone, quieter than damage impacts. A dry cloth rustle supports movement without masking action sounds.
required_art.risk: The circular staff opening must remain readable at distance; overly thin geometry will vanish. Mend must remain distinct from a shield bubble.

heroes.observed: Auburn bun, thick circle focus, coral mantle, satchel clasps/strap and teal details are visible.
heroes.outstanding: Hands still read as broad mitten forms and coat panels as relatively rigid slabs at gallery distance; continuous support-hand contact and late Victory staff clearance remain open.

required_art.silhouette: An angular, high folded collar above a tapered traveling coat, with a large open orb frame held beside the right shoulder. Broad sleeve cuffs distinguish him from staff-bearing Priests.
required_art.face: Copper-brown skin, round spectacles with thick readable rims, charcoal curls and an inquisitive half-smile. Use painted eyes rather than separate transparent lenses in the first pass.
required_art.costume: Indigo scholarâ€™s coat over an amber vest, reinforced fabric cuffs and calf-high boots. The coat splits into two stiff tails at the hips; no cloth simulation is required.
required_art.palette: Indigo #494774; amber #E2A148; parchment #E7D9B4; coal #38333E.
required_art.equipment: A hovering presentation-only ember orb inside a hand-held bronze bracket; a closed book fixed to the belt. The orb is not a summoned combat unit.
required_art.signature: High folded collar, round spectacles, and bright orb within an asymmetrical frame.
required_art.materials: Matte wool with broad color planes, worn bronze and a bounded emissive core. Reserve flame transparency for the brief active.
required_art.back: Two coat tails form an inverted V, and a stitched star diagram sits high on the shoulders. The closed book does not intersect the thighs while walking.
required_art.animation: Idle balances the orb with a restrained wrist movement. Move with compact forward steps. Basics flick a small spark. The active draws both hands inward then pushes the orb toward its captured ground location.
required_art.vfx: A small amber projectile expands into a low circular burst at the captured cell. Mark the radius briefly on the ground; no lingering fire damage exists.
required_art.audio: A brief rising furnace note followed by a soft magical pop; omit crackling loops once the burst resolves.
required_art.risk: The orb must be driven by a socket/presentation component, not physics. Camera brightness must not erase the unit or neighboring health bars.

heroes.observed: Round glasses, asymmetrical bracket, indigo coat, amber vest and angular collar are visible.
heroes.outstanding: The deliberately angular collar remains visually heavy. Two-hand gather, held bracket contact and actual core brightness need continuous engine review; no new hard static failure identified.

required_art.silhouette: A light forward-leaning profile, long crescent bow and three short leaflike cloak panels. The cloak stops above the knees, revealing long, narrow leg shapes.
required_art.face: Golden-brown skin, gray-green eyes, swept-back pointed ears and pale brown hair tied into a short fan. Her gaze is alert rather than severe.
required_art.costume: Moss fabric over fitted leather shoulder protection, a single pale scarf and flexible boots. The bow-side shoulder stays clear; no oversized pauldron blocks the draw.
required_art.palette: Moss #647A4B; pale mint #B7CBB0; chestnut #765641; warm linen #DACCAB.
required_art.equipment: A stylized crescent bow with broad flattened limbs and a slim back quiver. The bowstring is simplified geometry that can be hidden at distant LODs.
required_art.signature: Crescent bow, three separated cloak panels, and sideways archery stance.
required_art.materials: Matte woven cloth, satin-finished wood and leathery boots. Leaf motifs are broad seam shapes, not transparency cutouts.
required_art.back: Quiver sits diagonally and avoids the shoulder draw arc. Cloak panels spread enough to read as three shapes without requiring cloth bones beyond a small secondary chain.
required_art.animation: Idle scans in short head turns. Movement uses light lateral steps. Basics draw, pause visibly at release, and recover. Leafstep crouches briefly then slides through a controlled airborne step to the reserved cell.
required_art.vfx: A short mint leaf trail follows the dash and fades within half a second. No invisibility, shield or damage accompanies the dash.
required_art.audio: A soft bow snap and a brief brushlike dash sweep. Keep leaf rustle short and non-looping.
required_art.risk: Foot sliding during the dash is acceptable only within the deliberate magical slide, not normal walking. Reserved tile and displayed landing must agree.

heroes.observed: Pale hair fan, crescent bow, narrow legs and three cloak panels retained. Source8 connects the original sleeve roots into the torso.
heroes.outstanding: All seven action curves remain unchanged. Bow draw/string contact and dash landing still need continuous engine review; the observed source7 shoulder gap is repaired in source8.

required_art.silhouette: An upright pear-shaped silhouette with an open half-moon harp framing one shoulder. Layered petal-shaped sleeves form large, separated planes rather than many small leaves.
required_art.face: Deep umber skin, pale blue eyes and silver hair in a compact crown braid. Pointed ears remain visible on both sides of the harp.
required_art.costume: Blue-green tunic with ivory sleeve ends, a short overlapping overskirt and practical fitted boots. Silver trim follows one large curved line across the torso.
required_art.palette: Deep teal #337A80; moon ivory #E3E8DD; blue-gray #6E86A0; silver #B6C7C9.
required_art.equipment: A compact crescent harp held close to the torso, with only a few thick stylized strings. A small charm at the waist marks her order without introducing a resource.
required_art.signature: Open crescent harp, crown braid, and layered pale sleeve ends.
required_art.materials: Smooth cloth with sparse brocade normals, brushed silver and a faint cool glow on the harp rim. Do not use constantly glowing eyes.
required_art.back: Short robe panels leave the legs visible; a braided cord forms a clean circle high on the back. The harp must not clip through the spine during turning.
required_art.animation: Idle shifts a hand over the harp. Basic attacks pluck a single note. The active plants both feet and plays a broad chord, opening the elbows so the cast silhouette differs from an attack.
required_art.vfx: A low teal ring outlines affected adjacent cells, then small wing-shaped chevrons appear briefly over recipients. No continuous aura tick; recipients are snapshotted at release.
required_art.audio: One clear string note for basics and a restrained three-note chord for the skill. Separate the buff sound from Miraâ€™s healing bell.
required_art.risk: String geometry and hands can shimmer or intersect. Simplify the finger action and let the chordâ€™s full-body gesture carry readability.

heroes.observed: Silver crown braid, harp negative space and thick strings, teal tunic and pale sleeve petals are visible.
heroes.outstanding: Pale sleeve planes still read as thick rigid petals. Actual broad-chord/basic contrast, hand-string contact and rear clearance need continuous crowded engine review.

required_art.silhouette: A low asymmetrical stance with a short diagonal mantle, one raised scarf end and paired curved fantasy blades. His shoulders form a compact wedge rather than a broad warrior line.
required_art.face: Light bronze skin, dark hair swept to one side and narrow amber eyes. Keep the lower face visible, with no full mask that resembles a different character identity.
required_art.costume: Dusk-blue leather panels over pale gray cloth, light knee guards and a cross-body courier strap. The mantle covers only the left shoulder and ends at the waist.
required_art.palette: Dusk blue #3B4E6B; fog gray #BAC5CC; muted violet #786A8C; lantern amber #D2A35D.
required_art.equipment: Two short stylized curved blades and a small shielded courier lantern fixed to the belt. The lantern is a visual cue, not a source of stealth or detection gameplay.
required_art.signature: Single-shoulder mantle, paired curved silhouettes, and low forward stance.
required_art.materials: Supple matte leather, soft fabric and restrained brushed metal. No black-on-black costume and no constant translucent body.
required_art.back: Courier strap ends in a flat document case between the shoulder blades. Keep the case clear of both draw arcs.
required_art.animation: Idle balances on the balls of the feet. Walk uses quick narrow steps. Basics alternate readable cuts. The active compresses into a low stance and launches along a single clean line; no teleport smoke hides the destination.
required_art.vfx: A brief blue ribbon connects origin and landing, with a small landing ring. No bonus hit, invisibility, invulnerability or untargetability is implied.
required_art.audio: Short cloth snap and crisp magical sweep for the dash; attacks remain light rather than explosive.
required_art.risk: The dash can be tactically too strong against fragile backlines. Keep damage in normal attacks and test crowding, target validity and front/back targeting after landing.

heroes.observed: Single mantle, asymmetric curved blades, courier lantern/case and repaired source8 sleeve roots are present.
heroes.outstanding: The new Attack adds left-blade recovery guard after the original right-hand release. Alternating successive basic cuts required by the brief are not implemented by this single composite cycle; runtime presentation remains necessary. No extra hit or notify was added.

required_art.silhouette: A compact rectangular torso beneath a domed helmet, with wide rounded shoulder plates and an oversized bell-headed hammer. Short legs stay separated enough to read during motion.
required_art.face: Ruddy tan skin, large brown brows and a thick brown beard divided into two broad braids. A hinged-looking open helmet never hides the eyes.
required_art.costume: Slate plate over a moss-green padded coat, heavy riveted boots and a wide belt with a single square buckle. Avoid dozens of small rivets; bake secondary details.
required_art.palette: Slate #697A88; moss #6B7750; muted bronze #A58354; warm beard brown #76533A.
required_art.equipment: A two-handed fantasy hammer shaped like a solid bell housing. Its broad rim helps the stomp animation read without an actual moving bell interior.
required_art.signature: Domed open helmet, paired beard braids and bell-shaped hammer head.
required_art.materials: Rough forged metal, thick wool and a few worn bronze edges. Metal highlights should be broader and less bright than Adaâ€™s polished crest.
required_art.back: Overlapping short backplates terminate above the hips. Beard and shoulder plates need separate clearance zones during a downward cast.
required_art.animation: Idle rocks only slightly with the heavy hammer resting low. Walk is a deliberate short stride. Basics deliver compact side impacts. The active raises one foot and stamps while the hammer settles, emphasizing the ring on the ground.
required_art.vfx: A single amber ground ring and a clear stun marker over affected enemies. The ring has no damage component and no lingering slow.
required_art.audio: A low, short bell knock with a firm footfall. Do not layer a long reverberation for each affected target.
required_art.risk: Large shoulders and beard can hide the head at the gameplay angle; shorten the rear plate depth and test three Borins standing adjacent.

heroes.observed: Open helmet, two beard braids, low bell hammer with bronze rim and slate armor are visible.
heroes.outstanding: No additional hard static defect identified. Heavy hammer grip, beard/shoulder contact and face visibility among stocky neighbors need continuous engine checks.

required_art.silhouette: A compact upright body with a wide horizontal crossbow and a high single-lens goggle shape above the forehead. A short jacket flares just enough to contrast with the weapon bar.
required_art.face: Freckled medium-brown skin, dark eyes, cropped copper hair and a confident grin. Goggles sit above the eyes during normal play so expressions remain visible.
required_art.costume: Mustard work jacket over charcoal padding, leather forearm guards, sturdy trousers and broad boots. A few oversized straps suggest workshop practicality.
required_art.palette: Mustard #C5A04B; charcoal #404851; copper #B67B55; pale linen #D9CDAF.
required_art.equipment: A broad stylized crank crossbow with exaggerated fantasy housing and a circular side wheel. It is a game prop, not a functional construction plan; mechanisms remain decorative.
required_art.signature: Horizontal crossbow silhouette, forehead goggles and mustard jacket.
required_art.materials: Worn painted wood, brushed copper, matte leather and a tiny cool aiming-gem emissive point. Do not use transparent scope glass.
required_art.back: A flat bolt case is strapped low between the shoulders; jacket seams form a large X. Keep all parts outside the elbowsâ€™ reload arc.
required_art.animation: Idle checks the line of sight with a small tilt. Basics brace, fire and reset the bow. The active plants both feet, pulls the housing close and releases with a longer visible windup than a basic shot.
required_art.vfx: A bright compact bolt with a short trail and a sharp target flash. It never pierces or explodes.
required_art.audio: A dry mechanical click and compact fantasy bow thump; the active adds a short metallic accent rather than a firearm report.
required_art.risk: The wide prop can overlap neighboring units. Use its lowered rest pose outside windup and a close-to-body turn pose.

heroes.observed: Freckles, lifted goggles, mustard coat, horizontal crank crossbow and decorative side wheel are visible.
heroes.outstanding: Two-hand support and shot release remain continuous-review obligations; current static face clears the stock. Crossbow width still needs crowd and turn checks.

required_art.silhouette: A broad low center of gravity, square apron panels and a single large two-handed hammer held across the body. One uncovered upper sleeve breaks the armored outline without exposing a vulnerable-looking costume.
required_art.face: Deep brown skin, bright gray eyes and black hair in a thick high braid coiled at the back. A stern resting expression softens during the victory pose.
required_art.costume: Red workshop coat beneath segmented shoulder armor, a short split leather apron and heavy wrapped boots. Metal is limited to the shoulders, wrists and tool head.
required_art.palette: Brick red #A64E45; soot #4A4343; honey leather #A67E4B; steel #AAB2B7.
required_art.equipment: A blocky fantasy forge hammer with a large beveled face and short decorative rune strip. The tool reads from shape rather than detailed mechanical parts.
required_art.signature: Wide hammer bar, red split coat and squared apron silhouette.
required_art.materials: Coarse leather, wool, lightly worn iron and painted wood. Use broad edge accents to suggest craft rather than gritty damage.
required_art.back: A simple crossed harness stabilizes the hammer rest pose; the braid coil stays above the shoulder blades and outside the swing path.
required_art.animation: Idle holds the hammer diagonally with settled elbows. Walk uses strong grounded steps. Basics use a short overhead arc. The active pivots through one wide sweep, then returns to the same tile.
required_art.vfx: A low pale-gold sweep arc traces only the adjacent-cell ring; no knockback or extra stun.
required_art.audio: A broad whoosh and compact stone-on-metal fantasy impact, limited to one main active sound even with several victims.
required_art.risk: The sweep must not imply a larger hit radius than the data. Avoid excessive root rotation that changes gameplay facing or shifts the feet.

heroes.observed: Coiled braid, brick coat, square apron and beveled rectangular forge hammer are visible.
heroes.outstanding: The current portrait leaves her face clear; prior motion notes about hammer occlusion remain unresolved without continuous review. Pivot/heel lift and two-handed contact need checks.

required_art.silhouette: A tall broad-shouldered figure with a short circular shoulder mantle, compact fantasy axe and a visibly open stance. The weapon and torso create a diagonal, not Dagnaâ€™s horizontal bar.
required_art.face: Olive-green skin, small rounded tusks, warm amber eyes and black hair tied in a short topknot. Keep the expression determined but friendly, avoiding a permanent snarl.
required_art.costume: Sun-ochre woven mantle over brown padded armor, a red waist sash and practical high boots. The armor uses clean geometric plates with broad woven bands.
required_art.palette: Ochre #CAA454; red earth #A95E4D; dark leather #5E5040; muted green skin #6E8260.
required_art.equipment: A single broad stylized axe carried one-handed, with an open off-hand for balance. Its proportions communicate fantasy rather than realistic manufacturing.
required_art.signature: Round ochre mantle, topknot, and broad diagonal axe silhouette.
required_art.materials: Thick cloth, oiled hide, brushed iron and a restrained sun-pattern stitch. No spikes or trophy clutter.
required_art.back: A wide sash knot sits on one hip; the mantle is stiff enough for a short bone chain instead of simulation.
required_art.animation: Idle squares shoulders and rolls weight between feet. Basics use alternating short attacks. The active takes a clear breath and sets a quicker rhythm with a firm foot plant, not a transformation.
required_art.vfx: Three short amber speed marks rise from the arms and fade; the buff remains visible as a small icon, not a continuous flame layer.
required_art.audio: Rhythmic hand-drum accent and a restrained exhale, with ordinary attack impacts at the new cadence.
required_art.risk: Large proportions need a broad rig variant rather than scaling a human mesh uniformly. Keep hands and axe away from face during tempo changes.

heroes.observed: Topknot, tusks, circular ochre mantle, open off-hand, red sash and broad axe are visible.
heroes.outstanding: Current portrait is framed. The retained earlier axe extreme-pose margin case still requires current crowded gameplay checks; rounded hand/axe socket contact needs a closer pass.

required_art.silhouette: A tall stable stance beneath two broad crescent shoulder cloths, with a forked staff held outward. Her costume forms layered triangles rather than a conventional pointed wizard hat.
required_art.face: Sage-green skin, silver-gray eyes, modest tusks and dark hair braided into three thick sections. A calm upward gaze suggests listening to the weather.
required_art.costume: Storm-blue layered coat, pale wool collar, russet belt and wrapped boots. Fabric panels end above the ankles and open around the knees for movement.
required_art.palette: Storm blue #4A638D; cloud gray #CBD3DA; russet #A7664D; silver #A9B8C4.
required_art.equipment: A tall wooden staff with an open fork framing a small floating sky stone. No hanging chains that require physical simulation.
required_art.signature: Open forked staff, cloud collar and three thick braids.
required_art.materials: Wool, painted wood, oxidized silver and restrained cyan glow. Keep the sky stoneâ€™s bloom local.
required_art.back: Two long triangular coat panels split around the legs, with a broad stitched cloud arc high on the back.
required_art.animation: Idle makes a small palm-up listening gesture. Basics release small storm motes. The active raises the staff slowly, draws a visible circular path, then plants it as the captured area resolves.
required_art.vfx: A thin blue circle previews the captured radius during travel, followed by several short vertical magic streaks. The ability is one damage pulse, not damage over time or stun.
required_art.audio: Low rising wind followed by a short soft thunder chord, capped to avoid overwhelming every other cue.
required_art.risk: Radius two covers a large portion of a crowded board. Effects must show the true edge and performance tests must include multiple simultaneous rings.

heroes.observed: Fork negative space and small sky stone, pale cloud collar, layered blue coat and tusks are visible.
heroes.outstanding: Wide cloud-collar slabs and mitten-like staff hand remain fine craft/contact concerns. Staff sweep and crouch coat clearance need continuous review. Current portrait contains the staff tip.

required_art.silhouette: A narrow athletic wedge with a high scarf loop, short rounded shoulder guards and two compact hooked fantasy blades. The overall shape is tall and light rather than Rokâ€™s broad mantle.
required_art.face: Muted jade skin, brown eyes, small tusks and cropped dark hair with a pale cloth tie. An easy grin distinguishes him from a stereotypically menacing Rogue.
required_art.costume: Turquoise courier jacket over charcoal cloth, a tan diagonal sash and light wrapped boots. Large route-marker patches replace armor clutter.
required_art.palette: Turquoise #408E91; tan #C1A477; charcoal #3D4C4E; muted jade #708D72.
required_art.equipment: Two short rounded fantasy blades and a flat map case on the hip. Keep the implements stylized and visually simpler than Sylasâ€™s curves.
required_art.signature: High scarf loop, turquoise diagonal jacket and open forward-running posture.
required_art.materials: Waxed cloth, soft leather and minimal brushed metal. No transparent cape or spark trail during normal walking.
required_art.back: A route-map case sits close to the lower back, with a broad sash crossing above it. The scarf loop uses a few stiff bones rather than simulated cloth.
required_art.animation: Idle is ready to run, not constantly bouncing. Basics use economical alternating motions. The active lowers the lead shoulder and makes one fast grounded glide to the reserved cell.
required_art.vfx: A short pale-cyan streak hugs the ground; mark the landing rather than hiding the unit. No implicit extra strike or slow.
required_art.audio: A quick brushed-wind accent and light foot landing. Separate the cue from Sylasâ€™s longer dash with a shorter pitch envelope.
required_art.risk: The landing must reduce distance to the current target; otherwise a ready skill could loop without tactical purpose. Test same-tick target movement and blocked cells.

heroes.observed: Turquoise courier jacket, scarf loop, tan sash, close case and short blades are visible.
heroes.outstanding: CONFIRMED current source7 portrait defect: both upper sleeves terminate as exposed flat caps with gaps to the torso. Root authorized a targeted continuous sleeve-root repair after elf handoff. Do not treat this audit snapshot as the later repair result.

required_art.silhouette: A tall upright figure with one squared shoulder plate and a long, broad fantasy blade held diagonally downward. A short rectangular back-banner creates a distinctive vertical behind the head.
required_art.face: Medium-brown skin, close-cropped dark hair, brown eyes and a composed, focused expression. A pale eyebrow streak is a natural hair accent rather than an injury story.
required_art.costume: Deep red fitted coat under partial silver plate, broad belt, cream trousers and knee boots. The asymmetric armor leaves a clear leading and trailing side.
required_art.palette: Crimson #A4464D; cream #E3D7BA; silver #A6B5BF; midnight #344155.
required_art.equipment: Broad two-handed fantasy blade and a short banner fixed to a rigid back bracket. The banner is cosmetic; no area buff or faction system is implied.
required_art.signature: Single large shoulder plate, upright back-banner and long diagonal blade.
required_art.materials: Matte cloth and brushed steel with sparse clean edge highlights. Bake banner folds or use two accessory bones; no cloth solver.
required_art.back: A rigid banner bracket attaches visibly to the harness, leaving shoulder motion clear. The cloth stops above the hips.
required_art.animation: Idle keeps the blade low and feet apart. Basics are short two-handed cuts. The active pulls the blade inward and delivers one measured forward strike; the banner follows slightly after the torso.
required_art.vfx: A single narrow warm-white trail and compact impact spark. No splash damage, armor break or knockback.
required_art.audio: One firm cloth movement and a clean resonant hit; no shouted voice requirement.
required_art.risk: Banner silhouette must not overlap health bars or obscure the next row. Validate that a two-handed pose works with the shared standard rig.

heroes.observed: Crimson coat, pale brow streak, single shoulder plate, rigid-backed banner/bracket and long supported blade are visible; source5 eyes fit the head surface.
heroes.outstanding: Armor/cloth contact near the single pauldron and two-handed grip remain close-review concerns. Single-hit timing and banner safe area need continuous engine review.

required_art.silhouette: A narrow column of layered robes topped by a wide broken-circle headpiece. A small star-lens disk rests in the open left hand instead of a long staff.
required_art.face: Cool brown skin, pale violet eyes and midnight-blue hair braided into a smooth low knot. Long ears extend beneath the open headpiece.
required_art.costume: Violet coat over pale blue layered cloth, a fitted waist sash and short split lower panels. The headpiece is one bold arc, not a crown of many spikes.
required_art.palette: Violet #7465A5; pale blue #B4CADD; midnight #3E4166; pearl #E0E3D9.
required_art.equipment: A palm-sized star-lens in a thick silver ring and a flat chart case at the hip. Presentation magic is anchored to hand sockets.
required_art.signature: Broken-circle headpiece, open-hand star lens and clean vertical silhouette.
required_art.materials: Satin-like cloth with restrained specular response, brushed silver and a small emissive star. Keep the face the brightest non-emissive plane.
required_art.back: Long central seam and two overlapping panels create an open lower-leg gap. The chart case sits against the belt and cannot swing freely.
required_art.animation: Idle follows the lens with a small eye-line shift. Basics flick a pale spark. Starbind raises the lens to eye level, aligns both palms and releases one small star toward the target.
required_art.vfx: A pale violet projectile makes one compact magic impact, followed by a geometric ring above the surviving stunned target. Damage and stun share one impact; no chains, root or extra damage packets are added.
required_art.audio: A clean glass note with a short crystalline arrival tone. No long loop while the target is stunned.
required_art.risk: The headpiece can alias at low resolution; thicken it and test against bright sky. The control duration must not scale with stars.

heroes.observed: Cool-brown face, low knot, thick broken-circle headpiece, violet coat, lens and flat chart case are visible; source5 eyes fit the head.
heroes.outstanding: CONFIRMED sampled Active presentation gap: lens rises to upper chest, visibly below eye level requested by the brief; both-palms alignment needs a targeted motion review before claiming that requirement complete.

required_art.silhouette: A broad rounded coat, low lantern held at the chest and a soft arch-shaped head covering. Her gentle oval outline contrasts with Borinâ€™s rectangular armor.
required_art.face: Warm dark skin, lively brown eyes and silver hair arranged in two thick side braids. Her smile is restrained and dependable.
required_art.costume: Rust-red wool coat over cream cloth, a wide woven apron panel, short gloves and practical boots. The head covering is a padded travel hood, not a rigid helmet.
required_art.palette: Rust #AC6653; oatmeal #DCCEAF; forest #586B57; warm brass #BDA061.
required_art.equipment: A squat octagonal lantern carried on a short handle and a small folded cloth pouch. The lanternâ€™s heavy silhouette stays visible even when unlit.
required_art.signature: Low octagonal lantern, rounded hood and broad warm-colored coat.
required_art.materials: Thick wool, stitched canvas, dull brass and frosted-looking opaque lantern panes with emissive color. Avoid glass refraction.
required_art.back: A broad stitched hearth emblem and two large coat folds create readable planes. The hood must not stretch unnaturally during looking down.
required_art.animation: Idle lifts the lantern slightly as if checking a path. Basics release a small light mote. The active opens the free arm and raises the lantern, then settles into the same stance.
required_art.vfx: A low amber ring washes over adjacent allies once; small rising squares suggest warmth. No lasting zone, regeneration or shield.
required_art.audio: A warm bell cluster with a soft wooden resonance, distinct from Miraâ€™s higher single-target cue.
required_art.risk: Group-heal effects can look like a persistent aura. Make the one-shot pulse clear and cap repeated target sounds.

heroes.observed: Dark face, silver side braids, rounded hood/apron and thick octagonal lantern are visible; source4 face details fit.

required_art.silhouette: A wide arch formed by two high shoulder guards and a tall rectangular shield with a rounded top. The lower body remains a stable trapezoid.
required_art.face: Deep moss-green skin, warm brown eyes, small tusks and tightly braided dark hair. Her expression is attentive rather than aggressive.
required_art.costume: Layered leather-and-bronze armor, a pale ochre shoulder wrap, a blue woven sash and thick boots. Broad woven patterns identify her caravan community.
required_art.palette: Bronze #AC8658; ochre #D1B576; deep blue #405E78; moss #60765A.
required_art.equipment: A broad fantasy tower shield and a short ceremonial mace. The shield carries a simple interlocking-road emblem with no dense carving.
required_art.signature: Rounded tower shield, arched shoulders and a bold blue waist sash.
required_art.materials: Worn bronze, thick cloth and matte hide. Shield wear is painted as soft color variation rather than deep damage.
required_art.back: A flat travel pack sits beneath the shoulder line. Keep its volume low enough not to collide with the shield when turning.
required_art.animation: Idle angles the shield protectively toward adjacent allies. Basics use a short mace arc. Shared Guard plants the shield and extends the free hand outward, clearly signaling a group effect.
required_art.vfx: Several short amber shield outlines appear on eligible recipients; a brief ground ring shows reach. No continuous aura follows her afterward.
required_art.audio: One low shield chime and quiet recipient ticks, mixed as a single event rather than many full-volume sounds.
required_art.risk: Large shield and shoulders may occlude neighboring supports. Use a lowered idle pose and test the camera from both encounter orientations.

heroes.observed: Moss face, tight braids, arched shoulders, blue sash and rounded road-emblem tower shield are visible; source4 face details fit.

required_art.silhouette: A small broad stance with a large round wooden buckler and an upright leaf-shaped fantasy club. An oversized short scarf forms a clear horizontal at the neck.
required_art.face: Light brown skin, freckled cheeks, bright hazel eyes and dense chestnut curls. Keep the face friendly and visibly adult.
required_art.costume: Apple-green quilted jacket, ochre trousers, a red neck scarf and broad walking boots. Outfit proportions emphasize capable mobility, not toy-like baby features.
required_art.palette: Apple green #7A985A; ochre #BE9A59; berry red #A85251; walnut #73553B.
required_art.equipment: Round orchard-mark buckler and short stylized wooden club reinforced with decorative bronze bands. Both are exaggerated fantasy props.
required_art.signature: Circular buckler, large red scarf and wide planted stance.
required_art.materials: Quilted cloth, matte wood and dull bronze. Paint the orchard emblem in one readable silhouette.
required_art.back: A square travel patch on the jacket and scarf ends over one shoulder keep the rear identifiable.
required_art.animation: Idle is grounded rather than constantly bouncing. Walk uses quick full-foot steps. Basics are short determined swings. Stout Heart lifts the buckler with a compact upward hop that returns to the same logical cell.
required_art.vfx: A small green-gold shield outline that matches her scale. No taunt or healing accompanies it.
required_art.audio: A light wooden knock and short warm chime; avoid childish squeaks.
required_art.risk: Small units can disappear behind tall allies. Test camera spacing and health-bar anchors without enlarging her logical footprint.

required_art.silhouette: A small narrow body beneath a broad folded brim and a long simple bow carried upright. A narrow shoulder cape makes a triangular rear profile.
required_art.face: Tan skin, dark eyes, sandy curls and a thoughtful expression. The hat brim tilts upward enough not to hide his eyes.
required_art.costume: River-blue vest over cream sleeves, moss trousers, a short cape and simple boots. One broad belt pouch breaks the symmetrical torso.
required_art.palette: River blue #58899C; cream #E4DABC; moss #6F8158; warm brown #866243.
required_art.equipment: A slim fantasy bow and a compact quiver worn at the side. Keep the active projectile visibly magical instead of suggesting a real substance.
required_art.signature: Folded brim, upright long bow and blue triangular shoulder cape.
required_art.materials: Matte cloth, oiled wood and simple leather. No thin transparent feathers on arrows at gameplay distance.
required_art.back: The cape ends above the waist and leaves the side quiver visible; a stitched river line supplies one large motif.
required_art.animation: Idle checks the distance under the hat brim. Basics use quick controlled bow draws. The active pauses longer, aims carefully and releases one blue mote-tipped fantasy arrow.
required_art.vfx: Blue chevrons descend briefly over the target to indicate reduced attack tempo. No movement slow, poison or damage-over-time trail.
required_art.audio: A clear bow snap followed by a soft descending two-note magical cue.
required_art.risk: The debuff must remain distinguishable from stun. Do not show immobilizing chains or stop the targetâ€™s movement animation.

required_art.silhouette: A compact side-on stance with a short diamond-shaped cape and a high swept hair tuft. Two flat fanlike fantasy batons form a clear paired shape.
required_art.face: Rich brown skin, green-brown eyes and dark curls clipped at the sides. Her expression is mischievous without a villainous mask.
required_art.costume: Plum festival jacket, pale shirt, teal waist cord and sturdy close-fitting trousers. Small stitched stars appear only on one large lapel.
required_art.palette: Plum #785B83; teal #548B89; parchment #E1D4BB; dark cocoa #594838.
required_art.equipment: Paired short fanlike fantasy batons and a flat messenger pouch. Do not include lockpicking gear or realistic criminal instruction props.
required_art.signature: Diamond cape, swept hair tuft and paired broad baton ends.
required_art.materials: Smooth dyed cloth, matte leather and painted wood with a few metallic accents.
required_art.back: A single diagonal teal cord crosses the short cape. Pouch placement must not collide with quick turns.
required_art.animation: Idle rests in a sideways stance. Basics use short alternating taps. The active feints with the off-hand and makes one clear forward gesture; no disappearing body or forced camera cut.
required_art.vfx: A compact gold star above the target and a faint impact ring, then the shared stun marker. No damage packet.
required_art.audio: A quick double tap and a short bright bell accent.
required_art.risk: Fast motion can become unreadable on a small model. Preserve a brief anticipation pose and avoid motion blur as a substitute.

heroes.observed: Rich-brown adult face, solid swept tuft, plum jacket, teal cord and two broad fan batons are visible in source4 portrait.

required_art.silhouette: A round short travel coat, large upturned collar and a thick spiral-topped wand. A small rigid umbrella disk folded against the back adds a distinctive rounded shape.
required_art.face: Warm tan skin, gray eyes, a small dark mustache and wavy brown hair. Clearly adult proportions and expression; no oversized infant features.
required_art.costume: Sky-blue raincoat, cream collar, copper belt buckle and dark boots. Sleeves are wide but stop at the wrists for clean hand animation.
required_art.palette: Sky blue #77AFC2; cream #EAE0C7; copper #B78258; slate #566477.
required_art.equipment: A thick spiral fantasy wand and a collapsed decorative umbrella disk. The disk is not a shield or movement device.
required_art.signature: Spiral wand, upturned pale collar and round coat silhouette.
required_art.materials: Waxed cloth, painted wood and dull copper; use a small bounded emissive spiral rather than transparent mist clothing.
required_art.back: Umbrella disk is locked to a short bracket, clear of the head. The coat separates into two broad lower panels.
required_art.animation: Idle balances the wand with a curious head tilt. Basics send a small pale mote. The active makes one circular stir and flicks a cloudlet toward the captured target area.
required_art.vfx: A small blue-white cloud pops low to the board and vanishes. It does not blind, obscure the camera, slow movement or persist.
required_art.audio: A soft rising whistle followed by a light magical pop, without a continuous wind loop.
required_art.risk: Cloud effects can obscure units. Keep opacity low, lifetime short and the gameplay ring more readable than the vapor.

heroes.observed: Mustached adult face, wavy curls, sky-blue coat, high cream collar and thick spiral wand are visible in source2 portrait.

required_art.silhouette: A tall broad chest, short swept-back horns and an upright oval shield. A compact crest rises behind the forehead without adding wings or a tail.
required_art.face: Pearl-gold scales, deep amber eyes and a short rounded muzzle. Keep the mouth closed at rest and use a calm expression, not a permanent display of teeth.
required_art.costume: White-and-blue ceremonial armor with broad articulated panels, a short tabard and armored boots built around plantigrade feet.
required_art.palette: Pearl #E0D8C1; royal blue #486A9A; gold #C4A367; dark slate #4D5B67.
required_art.equipment: An oval fantasy shield with a single beacon gem and a short ceremonial mace. The gem is cosmetic outside the shield cast.
required_art.signature: Swept horns, oval beacon shield and pale armored torso.
required_art.materials: Matte scale normals at low frequency, brushed armor and one gem emissive mask. Do not model every scale.
required_art.back: A short raised neck crest ends above the shoulders. No wings, tail or dangling cloth; clear shoulders make retargeting manageable.
required_art.animation: Idle stands tall with the shield close. Walk uses slow deliberate steps. Basics strike compactly. The active angles the shield upward and lights the beacon disk before a protective shell forms.
required_art.vfx: A pale-gold shield outline with a small vertical glint, never a full-screen column of light.
required_art.audio: Low resonant chime and a measured armor movement; no roaring requirement.
required_art.risk: Muzzle, neck crest and shoulder plates need a draconic rig review. Do not force a human head mesh under a scale texture.

required_art.silhouette: A long narrow torso with a broad prismatic bow and two short outward horn fins. A split short cloak creates a forked shape without actual wings.
required_art.face: Blue-gray scales, pale gold eyes and a short angular muzzle. Horn fins are blunt and clearly part of the head rather than a wearable crown.
required_art.costume: Dark blue fitted ranger coat, ivory shoulder panels, silver belt and practical boots. The cloak ends at the hips.
required_art.palette: Blue gray #7996AC; deep blue #3F567A; ivory #E6DFC9; prism cyan #8BC9CA.
required_art.equipment: A stylized bow with broad translucent-looking but opaque shaded crystal facets. Keep its central grip readable and its mechanics decorative.
required_art.signature: Prismatic horizontal bow, short horn fins and forked cloak.
required_art.materials: Opaque faceted crystal shader, matte scale surface and soft cloth. Refraction is not required for the crystal look.
required_art.back: Cloak panels suggest folded wings in outline only; no hidden wing rig or flight ability. A flat quiver sits between them.
required_art.animation: Idle holds the bow low. Basics release pale magic arrows. The active rotates the bow slightly to align its facets, then fires one clear beamlike projectile with finite travel time.
required_art.vfx: One narrow cyan projectile and compact prismatic target sparkle. It does not pierce, chain or deal true damage.
required_art.audio: A crystalline bow note and a short clean impact, mixed below large area spells.
required_art.risk: Crystal materials can become too bright against snowlike backgrounds. Keep dark facet planes and verify readability without bloom.

required_art.silhouette: A slim low stance with a short swept neck crest, one long diagonal sash and paired broad crescent fantasy blades. The outline stays compact rather than spiky.
required_art.face: Muted copper scales, dark violet eyes and a short soft-edged muzzle. Two small backward horns sit close to the skull.
required_art.costume: Charcoal traveling jacket with coral lining, short layered hip panels and light boots. Leave elbow and knee shapes visible for agile poses.
required_art.palette: Copper #AF7C60; charcoal #454552; coral #CB7B6B; muted violet #837B9E.
required_art.equipment: Paired fantasy crescent blades with small pale inset gems. The true-damage fantasy comes from a brief magical effect, not realistic cutting detail.
required_art.signature: Close neck crest, coral diagonal sash and paired crescents.
required_art.materials: Matte scales, soft cloth and restrained metal. Keep gem glow off except during the active.
required_art.back: The sash crosses a flat back panel; no tail or wings. Neck crest must clear the shoulder blades during crouches.
required_art.animation: Idle is still and balanced. Basics are compact alternating attacks. Prism Cut draws one crescent inward, pauses for a readable glint and releases a short deliberate gesture.
required_art.vfx: A thin white-violet impact mark and the ordinary damage number with a distinct true-damage icon. No injury detail, teleport or invulnerability.
required_art.audio: A clean bright note with a soft impact tick; avoid harsh scraping sounds.
required_art.risk: True damage can erase defensive choices if overtuned. Its magnitude is deliberately lower than same-tier physical or magic skills and belongs only to expansion.

required_art.silhouette: A tall narrow silhouette framed by a short mantle and a large open lantern staff. Two rounded swept horns form an unobtrusive arch above the head.
required_art.face: Pale moss-gray scales, warm gold eyes and a short rounded muzzle. The face should appear attentive and scholarly rather than ferocious.
required_art.costume: White traveling robes with deep teal panels, short gold-edged mantle and fitted lower-leg wraps. Split robe panels stop above the ankles.
required_art.palette: White linen #E5E2D3; teal #3E7F83; moss gray #92A69D; pale gold #C4AC72.
required_art.equipment: A long staff with an open hexagonal lantern frame and a small sealed map case. No books float as independent actors.
required_art.signature: Hexagonal lantern head, rounded swept horns and teal vertical robe panels.
required_art.materials: Matte cloth, subtle scale normal, brushed gold and frosted opaque lantern panels. Keep glowing area small.
required_art.back: A single wide teal panel and short mantle define the rear. Horns clear the staff during over-shoulder poses.
required_art.animation: Idle rests the staff near the body. Basics release a small light mote. The active turns the lantern toward the selected ally and lifts the free palm, producing a visibly directed ward.
required_art.vfx: A pale-gold line leads briefly to the recipient, then a hexagonal shield outline appears. It is protection, not healing or revival.
required_art.audio: A restrained bell with a short sustaining tail cut on expiry; avoid one continuous sound per shielded target.
required_art.risk: The selected ally may already carry a stronger shield. Candidate validation and replacement rules must prevent wasted weak overwrites.
